fields.offer: A specialist agent, such as a supplier’s stock agent. Here the agent is the resource.
fields.request: A customer’s purchasing agent, with its own identity linked to its owner, asks for stock levels and places an order. Here the agent is the caller.
fields.authorize: The supplier verifies the customer’s attestation and its own treaty. Its policy allows the purchasing role and requires a person’s approval above a set amount.
fields.admit: None for a query. An order can hold stock until its approval expires.
fields.enforce: The supplier’s tool gateway exposes only the approved operations and data sources.
fields.outcome: Completed or refused. If the connection drops, the order is unknown until the same request ID is checked, so no second order is placed.
fields.evidence: Each side keeps the signed request, decision, approval and outcome, and verifies the other side’s signatures.

fields.offer: A job runner on idle machines, built on an existing container sandbox or scheduler.
fields.request: An agent submits one job: a workload image digest, input digests, and CPU, memory and time limits.
fields.authorize: The provider’s policy allows approved images from recognized members, within its limits.
fields.admit: The runner reserves capacity and returns a lease that the requester can cancel.
fields.enforce: The sandbox isolates the job, blocks network egress and stops it at the deadline.
fields.outcome: Started, completed, failed, cancelled or unknown. Unknown is resolved by request ID, never by running the job again.
fields.evidence: Output digests and the resources the provider reports. Billing needs agreed units and reconciliation on top.

fields.offer: A temporary desktop through an existing remote-desktop gateway.
fields.request: A contractor asks to open the project desktop for the day.
fields.authorize: The company’s policy accepts the contractor agency’s attestation for this project, under its treaty with the agency.
fields.admit: A desktop is provisioned and a session lease issued.
fields.enforce: The gateway limits clipboard, file transfer and peripherals. Renewal of the lease rechecks the attestation and treaty.
fields.outcome: Started, completed, cancelled, or ended when renewal is refused.
fields.evidence: Session start, renewals and end, recorded for both sides.

fields.offer: Queries over a dataset, instead of copies of it.
fields.request: A partner’s analyst asks for regional sales totals.
fields.authorize: Only approved query templates on approved datasets are allowed for that partner.
fields.enforce: The data adapter runs the template and filters the result.
fields.outcome: Completed, or refused with the reason.
fields.evidence: Each disclosure: who asked, which template, and the digest of the result.

fields.offer: One machine on a factory floor or in a lab.
fields.request: A maintenance vendor asks to run a diagnostic.
fields.authorize: The vendor’s technicians are allowed named commands in a set time window.
fields.admit: The device reserves a maintenance slot.
fields.enforce: The device adapter accepts only those commands. Offline it acts under a grant with use limits, and learns of revocations at its next feed read.
fields.outcome: Completed, refused or failed, for each command.
fields.evidence: Every command and its result, signed by the device.

fields.offer: Backup space on a family member’s NAS.
fields.request: Your laptop asks to store tonight’s encrypted backup.
fields.authorize: Family members get a quota and a retention period.
fields.admit: Space is reserved for the backup.
fields.enforce: The storage adapter enforces the quota. Only you hold the encryption key.
fields.evidence: Each backup and restore, with the digest of what was stored.

fields.offer: A folder on your laptop, shared as a Space. Connect does this within one network today, in development.
fields.request: A family member’s phone asks to open a file in the Space.
fields.authorize: Your network’s authority checks their membership and the Space’s policy.
fields.enforce: Your device serves only that Space, and only until the share expires.
fields.outcome: Allowed, or refused as busy, expired or denied.
